title: SQLite Databases
intro: Learn the basic ideas of SQLite Databases in simple English. Read the explanation and example first; the quiz asks only from the concepts taught here.

items.heading: SQLite
items.text: SQLite is a lightweight relational database engine that stores data in a local database file.

items.heading: sqlite3 module
items.text: Python’s sqlite3 module provides an interface for working with SQLite databases.

items.heading: Connection
items.text: A database connection represents the link between the Python program and the database.

items.heading: Table
items.text: A table stores related data in rows and columns.

items.heading: Primary key
items.text: A primary key uniquely identifies each row in a table.

items.heading: SELECT
items.text: SELECT retrieves rows or columns from a database.

items.heading: INSERT
items.text: INSERT adds new rows to a table.

items.heading: UPDATE
items.text: UPDATE changes existing rows that match a condition.
items.code: UPDATE users SET name=? WHERE id=?

items.heading: DELETE
items.text: DELETE removes rows that match a condition.

items.heading: Parameterized queries
items.text: Placeholders and parameters keep user data separate from SQL code and reduce SQL injection risk.

items.heading: Transactions
items.text: A transaction groups database changes so they can be committed together or rolled back when needed.
